The main takeaway from our work is that

, in a recommender, the user item interaction can serve as a good proxy for the latent user item preference and the perturbations in the interaction layer can be used to generate adversarial examples.
, by exploiting the semantic rich user-item interactions in recommender systems, we can effectively improve the recommendation performance.
